images.caption: Figure 2:PILOTimplements live self-improvement through two mechanisms: live steering and live self-evolution.Top left: a single ReAct loop has no oversight separate from the work.Bottom left: a main agent receives a subagent’s output only after the delegated run ends.Right: a separate supervisor redirects or aborts the active worker, distils reusable skills and memory from supervision, and makes the evolved harness available to later workers.
